<thought>Since the previous searches returned no templates, I will broaden the criteria to include the bond changes described: formation of a C‑C bond (likely aromatic‑aromatic, “6-6”) and a C‑O ether bond (“6-8”), and breaking of a C‑O carbonyl bond (order change from double to single). Including these bond criteria should retrieve the appropriate retrosynthetic template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-8 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
